title.en: Start here: the sample questions, and how we will learn them
title.zh: 从这里开始：这些样题，以及我们怎么学

description.en: What the ten sample questions of the review lectures ask, why the lessons come in this order, and the two habits that earn the marks in a short answer.
description.zh: 复习课的十道样题各问什么，课为什么按这个顺序排，以及简答题拿分的两个习惯。

text.en: In Week 12, both review lectures end with sample questions of the kind the final exam asks. Review (1) has three; two of them are questions 5 and 16 of the practice exam. Review (2) has seven, with the lecturer's answers. Together they visit every part of the course: sharing a channel, the transport layer, congestion control, DNS, the web, email and multimedia, and security.
text.zh: 第 12 周的两节复习课，最后都给了样题，题型就是期末会考的那种。复习课 (1) 有三道，其中两道是模拟卷的第 5 题和第 16 题；复习课 (2) 有七道，附了老师的答案。合起来正好走遍整门课：共享信道、传输层、拥塞控制、DNS、网页、邮件和多媒体、网络安全。

text.en: Here is each question as a story. Every lesson starts with its question exactly as printed.
text.zh: 先用一句话看看每道题讲的是一件什么事。每一课都从题目原文开始。

rows.en: A busy office network: when everyone wants to send, which way of sharing the cable wastes less?
rows.zh: 一个很忙的办公室网络：大家都想发的时候，哪种共用电缆的办法浪费更少？

rows.en: A program on one computer wants to talk to a program on another. What does it need to know?
rows.zh: 一台电脑上的程序想和另一台电脑上的程序说话。它需要知道什么？

rows.en: Calling a function on a remote server: when is the light, unreliable UDP the better carrier, and when TCP?
rows.zh: 调用远程服务器上的函数：什么时候用轻而不可靠的 UDP 更好，什么时候用 TCP？

rows.en: TCP has just lost a segment. How fast does it dare to send for the next four round trips?
rows.zh: TCP 刚丢了一个报文段。接下来四个往返，它敢发多快？

rows.en: Every DNS server in the world crashes at once. What can you still do online?
rows.zh: 全世界的 DNS 服务器同时崩溃。你还能在网上做什么？

rows.en: One connection kept open for a whole web page: what it saves, and what it costs.
rows.zh: 为整个网页保持一条连接不断开：省了什么，又付出了什么。

rows.en: Email's protocol, SMTP: one strength and one weakness.
rows.zh: 邮件协议 SMTP：一个优点，一个缺点。

rows.en: Why music and video are compressed in a way that throws information away.
rows.zh: 为什么音乐和视频要用会丢信息的方式压缩。

rows.en: An encrypted file must be read from the middle. Which way of running the cipher allows it?
rows.zh: 一个加密文件要从中间开始读。密码用哪种工作方式才行？

rows.en: Seven messages between Alice, a directory and Bob: after which one can Alice be sure she is talking to Bob?
rows.zh: Alice、目录和 Bob 之间的七条消息：到哪一条，Alice 能确定对面是 Bob？

title.en: Why the lessons come in this order

text.en: The lessons follow the layers from the cable up, so each one only uses what came before:
text.zh: 课的顺序从电缆往上，沿着网络的层次走，每一课只用到前面讲过的东西：

items.en: **A busy shared channel** (the MAC sublayer): computers that share one cable or one radio channel must decide who speaks.
items.zh: **忙碌的共享信道**（MAC 子层）：共用一根电缆或一个无线信道的电脑，得决定谁来说话。

items.en: **Reaching a process** (the transport layer): ports, and what UDP and TCP each promise.
items.zh: **找到一个进程**（传输层）：端口，以及 UDP 和 TCP 各自承诺了什么。

items.en: **Congestion control**: how TCP decides how fast to send. It needs the TCP of lesson 2.
items.zh: **拥塞控制**：TCP 怎么决定发多快。要用到第 2 课的 TCP。

items.en: **Opening a web page** (DNS and HTTP): first the name becomes an address, then the page comes over TCP. It needs lessons 2 and 3.
items.zh: **打开一个网页**（DNS 和 HTTP）：先把名字变成地址，再通过 TCP 把网页取回来。要用到第 2、3 课。

items.en: **Email and multimedia**: two more applications, each with its own trade-offs.
items.zh: **邮件与多媒体**：另外两种应用，各有各的取舍。

items.en: **Encrypting a file** and **proving who you are**: security, which stands on its own.
items.zh: **给文件加密**和**证明你是谁**：网络安全，自成一块。

title.en: What earns the marks in a short answer

text.en: Almost every one of these questions says *briefly explain*. The answer is two to four sentences, and each sentence must carry a reason. Two habits help almost every time.
text.zh: 这些题几乎都写着 *briefly explain*（简要解释）。答案两到四句话，但每句话都得带着理由。有两个习惯几乎每次都管用。

text.en: Half of the questions ask you to choose between two designs: contention or collision-free, UDP or TCP, a connection kept open or closed, lossy or lossless, counter mode or a chained mode. Neither design is simply better: each buys something and pays for it. A full-mark answer names the choice, the condition that makes it right, and the mechanism. For example: *under high load, collision-free, because stations that send when ready collide constantly, while stations that take turns never collide.*
text.zh: 一半的题要你在两种设计之间选：竞争还是无冲突，UDP 还是 TCP，连接保持还是关掉，有损还是无损，计数器模式还是链式模式。没有哪种设计是单纯更好的：每种都换来了一些东西，也为此付了代价。满分答案要说出选哪个、在什么条件下选它对、以及背后的机制。比如：*高负载时选无冲突，因为有帧就发的站会不停地撞车，而轮流发的站永远不会撞。*

text.en: What exactly it does, and what follows when it is gone
text.zh: 它到底做什么，没了它会怎样

text.en: The other half ask about one piece: DNS, a port, a random number inside a protocol. Say its one job precisely, then follow the consequences step by step. For example: *DNS turns names into addresses; without it, nothing that starts from a name can find its server, but anything that already has the address still works.*
text.zh: 另一半问的是某一个部件：DNS、端口、协议里的一个随机数。先准确说出它的那一项职责，再一步一步推后果。比如：*DNS 把名字翻译成地址；没有它，凡是从名字出发的都找不到服务器，但已经知道地址的照样能用。*

text.en: Each lesson ends with an answer written the way it would earn full marks, and says where the marks are.
text.zh: 每一课最后都有一份按满分标准写的答案，并说明分在哪里。

items.en: **The question**, as printed (in English, with the Chinese under it), then a slow read: what each term means and what exactly is asked.
items.zh: **题目**原文（英文，下面附中文），然后慢慢读一遍：每个术语是什么意思，到底在问什么。

items.en: **The ideas** the question needs, from the ground up, with figures; you can drag some of them.
items.zh: **需要的想法**，从头讲起，配上图；有些图可以拖动。

items.en: **On the exam paper**: the answer built link by link, then written out as a full-mark answer.
items.zh: **写在卷面上**：一环一环把答案搭起来，再写成一份满分答案。

items.en: **The wider topic**: what else the exam can ask here, taught the same way.
items.zh: **这类题的全貌**：这个话题下考试还可能问什么，同样讲清楚。

items.en: **Your turn**: new questions. Some you answer in your own words, and the tutor marks them against the points an examiner looks for.
items.zh: **你来**：新的题。有些要你用自己的话作答，由助教按阅卷人看重的要点来批改。

text.en: The last lesson puts every answer pattern on one page, with a drill to do under time.
text.zh: 最后一课把所有答题套路放在一页上，再加一组限时练习。

body.en: The Chinese version keeps the English terms beside the Chinese, and every full-mark answer is in English, so you can write in the words the examiner expects.
body.zh: 中文版在专业词旁边保留英文，满分答案也用英文写，方便你直接用阅卷人熟悉的词作答。
